rooms.name: Bar Front Steps
dressing: Rainwater sheets off the sagging canvas awning in a solid curtain
The bar's shutter trembles as something inside slides the deadbolt home
A gutter overhead gushes a brown waterfall into the gutter
Faint smell of spilled beer and wet cardboard from the crates by the door

hiddenDressing.text: Fresh scratch marks, fingernail-deep, raked across the inside edge of the shutter

rooms.name: Flooded Intersection
rooms.description: Four streets meet under a dead traffic light that sways and creaks in the wind. Floodwater runs ankle-deep toward a choked storm drain, and abandoned cars sit dark and silent in every direction.
dressing: Dead traffic light swinging overhead with a long metallic groan
Floodwater tugging steadily at your ankles toward the drain
A newspaper plastered flat against a car windshield, ink bled to grey
Thunder rolling so low it shakes water off the car roofs

hiddenDressing.text: Handprints on the inside of a sedan's fogged windows, the door still locked from within

rooms.name: Bus Shelter
rooms.description: A plexiglass bus shelter leans against the storm, its bench dry beneath the roof. The route map behind the glass is bleached and peeling, and something has smeared mud down one panel in long streaks.
dressing: Rain drumming on the thin metal roof like static
A soaked jacket abandoned on the bench, still folded
Mud smeared in long dragging streaks across one plexiglass panel
The shelter hums faintly when lightning strikes nearby

hiddenDressing.text: A transit schedule with every route crossed out in marker except one circled stop several blocks away

rooms.name: Dumpster Alley
rooms.description: A narrow alley walled in by wet brick, choked with dumpsters and the smell of rot. Rats pour along the base of the wall in a panicked stream, all fleeing deeper into the dark.
dressing: Rats streaming along the wall in one direction, frantic and silent
Rainwater overflowing a blocked downspout in a brown sheet
The reek of rotting garbage sharpened by the wet
A fire escape ladder swaying a few inches above reach

hiddenDressing.text: A nest of dragged-together trash behind the far dumpster, arranged almost like bedding

rooms.name: Subway Entrance
rooms.description: Stairs dive underground between rusted railings, exhaling warm stagnant air. The tiled passage below is lit only by one dying emergency light, and the water down there is moving the wrong way.
dressing: Warm stale air breathing up out of the tunnel against the cold rain
A single emergency light flickering deep below, strobing the wet tiles
Floodwater flowing UP the lower steps in slow pulses
A turnstile below spinning lazily on its own

hiddenDressing.text: Dozens of small pale shapes clustered at the waterline below, gone the next time lightning flashes

rooms.name: Overturned Ambulance
rooms.description: An ambulance lies on its side across two lanes, rear doors flapping open and shut in the wind. Medical supplies are scattered through the rainwater inside, and the radio hisses a dead channel.
dressing: Rear doors slamming open and shut with the wind in a slow arrhythmic beat
Bandage wrappers and syringe caps swirling in the standing water
The cab radio hissing an empty channel, volume knob broken off
Rain ticking hard against the sideways windshield

hiddenDressing.text: A patient log clipped inside the cab, the last entry noting a transfer to the beacon building's address

rooms.name: Pharmacy Storefront
rooms.description: The pharmacy's glass door is smashed and the shelves inside are half-stripped. Rain blows in across the hex tile, and somewhere in the dark back aisles something knocks a bottle off a shelf, waits, and knocks another.
dressing: Bottles rolling loose across the tile whenever thunder shakes the shelves
Rain blowing through the smashed door in fine cold spray
A security mirror in the corner showing slices of dark aisles
The smell of crushed pills and wet cardboard

hiddenDressing.text: The dispensing cabinet's lock was opened cleanly with a key before being left to look ransacked

rooms.name: Police Barricade
rooms.description: A checkpoint of sawhorses, sandbags, and a single squad car blocks the avenue, long abandoned. Shell casings glitter in the floodwater, and the squad car's lightbar is smashed dark.
dressing: Police tape pasted flat against the sandbags by the rain
Brass casings glinting in the runoff around the squad car's tires
A loudspeaker on a tripod, cone down, dripping
Sandbags slumped and burst, spilling wet sand into the gutter

hiddenDressing.text: All the casings are concentrated behind the barricade facing AWAY from the barricade, as if the line broke from the rear

rooms.name: Sunken Underpass
rooms.description: The street dives under a rail bridge and comes up as a black lake. Waist-deep water fills the underpass from wall to wall, and the car roofs poking out of it look like stepping stones. The beacon blinks red through the rain on the far side.
dressing: The underpass booming like a drum with every thunderclap
Car roofs breaking the water's surface at irregular intervals
An oily rainbow sheen swirling where the current eddies
The beacon's red blink reflecting in the floodwater in long smears
Something bumping gently against a submerged car, over and over

hiddenDressing.text: A maintenance walkway runs along the wall above the waterline, its access ladder rusted but intact

rooms.name: Wrecked City Bus
rooms.description: A city bus sits jackknifed against a lamppost, doors open, every window fogged from the inside. The destination display flickers between garbled characters, and a dark smear runs the full length of the aisle.
dressing: The destination sign stuttering between nonsense characters in orange light
Every window fogged from the inside despite the cold
A dark drag smear running down the aisle and out the open doors
Rain hissing through the broken roof hatch

hiddenDressing.text: The fog on the windows is disturbed by writing from the inside: a single word, wiped and rewritten many times

rooms.name: Courtyard of the Dead
rooms.description: An open plaza between buildings where the wind dies to nothing. Shapes stand motionless in the rain between the planters — dozens of them, faces tilted up, letting the storm wash over them, unmoving until you move.
dressing: Utter stillness between thunderclaps — even the wind drops dead here
Planters overflowed into black slurry across the paving
Dozens of pale faces tilted up toward the rain, eyes open
The beacon's blink strobing them all red, one frame at a time

hiddenDressing.text: Every figure in the courtyard is facing the same direction — toward the beacon building

rooms.name: Generator Truck
rooms.description: A utility truck idles rough and loud in the lee of a building, a towed generator hammering behind it. Thick cables run from the generator down the block toward the beacon building, disappearing through a propped door.
dressing: The generator's hammering drone audible even under the thunder
Diesel sheen rainbowing across the puddles at the truck's wheels
Cables thick as wrists running taut down the sidewalk and through a propped-open door
The truck's cab empty, wipers still beating

hiddenDressing.text: The generator's fuel gauge is near empty — someone refills it on a schedule, and the schedule is overdue

rooms.name: Collapsed Awning
rooms.description: A storefront awning has torn loose and folded down across the sidewalk, canvas belly-full of rainwater. It makes a low tunnel along the wall — the only covered path on the block.
dressing: Gallons of trapped rainwater sloshing in the canvas belly overhead
The awning frame ticking as it settles against the wall
A dry strip of sidewalk beneath the collapse, littered with cigarette ends

hiddenDressing.text: Someone has been sheltering under here regularly — a scuffed clean patch and a stash of bottle caps arranged by size

rooms.name: Cratered Avenue
rooms.description: Something has blown the avenue open — a crater twenty feet across, its rim of asphalt slabs tilted like broken teeth. A burst main gushes steadily into the pit, and the detour around it squeezes between the crater and a row of dark shopfronts.
dressing: A burst water main gushing white noise into the crater
Asphalt slabs tilted at the rim like broken teeth
Mud streaming down off the crater lip with every gust of rain
Shopfront grates rattling along the narrow detour path

hiddenDressing.text: The crater is not scorched — the asphalt is pushed UP from below, as if something came out rather than fell in

rooms.name: Apartment Steps
rooms.description: A broad stoop rises out of the flood to a glass-fronted lobby, the red beacon on the roof blinking down through the rain like a heartbeat. The generator cables run up these steps and under the door. Something very large is slumped against the railings, and it is breathing.
dressing: The beacon's red pulse washing over the stoop in slow heartbeat rhythm
Generator cables snaking up the steps and under the lobby door
Deep gouges in the lobby door's frame, knuckle-height and head-height
Rain overflowing the stoop's gutters in silver ropes

rooms.name: Apartment Building Lobby
rooms.description: Inside, the storm drops to a muffled roar. Battery lanterns glow on the mail shelves, someone has dragged furniture into a barricade at the stairwell, and against the far wall a field radio transmitter squats on a folding table, its looped evacuation message still hissing through a battered speaker.
dressing: Battery lanterns throwing warm steady light over the mail shelves
The looped evacuation message hissing from a battered speaker, calm and wrong
Furniture stacked into a careful barricade at the stairwell door
The storm reduced to a muffled roar behind the glass
Generator cables running along the baseboard, warm to the touch

hiddenDressing.text: The broadcast log's last entry is dated three days ago — the loop has been running unattended ever since

questChain.name: The Last Beacon
questChain.description:
- Fight through the flooded, infected-choked streets between the bar and the apartment building flashing the generator beacon.
- Reach the building and find a way inside before the storm or the dead close every route — the beacon is the only light still burning on this avenue.
- Confirm what's actually there: power, shelter, and whether the transmitter that broadcast the evacuation loop is real and still manned.

questChain.name: Voice on the Loop
questChain.description:
- Reach the field radio transmitter on the lobby's folding table and examine the broadcast setup.
- Check the handwritten broadcast log to learn who has been sending the evacuation message — and how long ago they stopped.

questChain.name: The Gatekeeper
questChain.description:
- The pounding on the lobby glass was never the storm — the huge infected slumped at the stoop has followed you in.
- Put down the Bloated Gatekeeper before it wrecks the transmitter and the lobby's barricade.
